strongest_angle: Examine Assembly Bill 1905 signed by Governor Gavin Newsom, which restricts deceptive undercover Perkins operations targeting youth and minors in California.

key_facts.fact: Governor Gavin Newsom signed Assembly Bill 1905 to limit deceptive undercover police operations, known as Perkins operations, targeting young people facing criminal allegations.
Assembly Bill 1905 was authored by Democratic Assemblymember Nick Schultz of Burbank and chaptered as Chapter 559 of the 2026 Statutes.
Perkins operations involve undercover law enforcement agents posing as incarcerated individuals to elicit information from suspects.
Existing law and Assembly Bill 1905 address protections during custodial interrogations and operations involving individuals age 17 or younger or certain people under age 26.
